queue_order: pilot: Conker B1, Conker A1 (the most watch-heavy title). After the pilot is read: Blinx 2 B/A, Forza B/A, Crimson B. Each: env HAKUX_RELEASE_PRIO=1 docs/testing/request.sh --who lane.memfast --issue 507 --title <title> [--route <route>] --seconds 300 --perflog --device nova --ref <ref> --expect docs/testing/predictions/memfast-w1-soak.json
judge: docs/lanes/memfast/w1_read.py <result dir> ([tlb68] and [watch311] lines over the whole run); title_verdict.py on a COPY of each dir for reach, crash and hang.
prediction: #507 phase 2 W1: the full flush per surface-watch insert and remove is replaced by a walk that drops only the entries mapping the watched RAM. a_ref is master plus docs (no emulator change); b_ref is W1.

legs.V (validity): Per run: at least 100 [tlb68] lines and at least one [watch311] line; a run without them is VOID and re-queued once. Every B line has w1=1.
legs.M (mechanism, the point): Whole run, per pair: B's fo per second is at most 10% of A's on Conker, Blinx 2 and Forza (A: about 2 x watch inserts, section 8). On B, wn per second is within 0.8-1.25 x of 2 x [watch311] inserts per second.
legs.P (a cost W1 can create; observation, fr: A mode's recorded large-page region (tlb_add_large_page) is reset only by a full flush of that mode. With the watch flushes gone it stays wide, so an INVLPG inside the kernel's 4 MB RAM mapping flushes the whole mode ([tlb68] pfl). Reported per pair: B's pfl/s against A's, and B's ff/s (all causes) against A's. If B's pfl/s exceeds half of A's fo/s, the saving is being spent there, and the next change is to reset the region on a walk that empties it.
legs.X (coverage cross-check): wx = 0 on every [tlb68] line of every B run: the host-pointer test never drops an entry the RAM-address test kept. Any wx > 0 refutes the claim that xlat_section recovery covers every entry, and the fix stays off until it is explained.
legs.C (vCPU cost; a guess, labelled as one): vCPU thread CPU ms per wall second (sum of cpu= over sum of dt=, whole run): B/A <= 0.97 on Conker. Guessed from section 8 (5-15% of Conker's vCPU). Refuted if B/A >= 1.00 on all three paired titles. One pair per title, so a 3% move is within noise; it decides nothing alone.
legs.G (exactness in play): B on Forza and Crimson reaches `mark gameplay`; no B run has crash or hang (title_verdict.py), and [tlb68] lines continue to the end of every B run. The B contact sheets show no stale or torn surface the A sheets do not.

expect_note: EMPTY ON PURPOSE: a soak writes no captures; the pixel half is memfast-w1-pixels.json
